openDecisions.decision: Allow candidate importer/schema work before runtime import so officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, endpoint clusters, tails/connectors, and source-direction reversal metadata can be represented.
Keep loops/connectors out of the main 9-stage route unless the import supports separate connector/tail objects.
Suppress natural water as potable unless reliable point-source evidence is verified.
